|game_text=Cancels Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent's character at an interior Cloud City site and draw destiny. |notes=The Set 6 sources preserve this publication of Slip Sliding Away. The first surviving wording says to move the opponent’s character to Weather Vane, where the remaster says relocate. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=63 period Weather Vane rule] treats placement on the Effect as involving no movement. Both keep the same target, timing, destiny threshold and other modes.
